integrity: The real-input theorem, its constant 2, its uniformity in dimension and drift, the primary MSC classification, and the complex L2 identity were checked in the full current primary text. The extension is proved independently by an exact angular projection lemma, Tonelli's theorem, and a one-variable optimization. Decimal constants are evaluations of the exact equation theta*tan(theta)=1.
scientific_limitations: The result gives an explicit dimension-free upper bound for the natural complexification of the real weak-L1 theorem. It does not claim optimality of the constant, construct a complex obstacle decomposition, or cover non-Hilbert target norms.
title: A dimension-free complex-input endpoint for Riesz transforms with constant drift
